comments_data.body:
Thanks @lilitkarapetyan - but this is more advanced than we need.

It _looks like_ this PR tells the server when an interaction happens.

I don't think we need that level of network activity.  Instead, I think this is enough:
- when these interactions happen:
    - store the time of the interaction (`mostRecentActivity`)
- when heartbeat request is sent:
    - pass the `mostRecentActivity` time in the request, which the server stores (instead of the time of heartbeat)

I hope this makes sense.

Nice work, thanks @lilitkarapetyan 

```
expiredStorage.setItem('activityTime', `${new Date().getTime()}`)
```

Could you swap instances of this bit of code with calls to a function please?

Then, if we want to modify the _activity-tracking_, we only have to do it in one place.

@lilitkarapetyan - the logic is still a little confused here.

We have the `healthcheck` and `playerlog` messages.  Currently:
* `healthcheck` is passing the `activity-time` in the **get** which returns the status
* `playerlog` is **posting** `wargame` and `role` - and the server is injecting the current time
* `playerlog` is **getting** the log of activity for the specified wargame

We need to modify `healthcheck` to send `activity-time`, `activity-type`, `wargame` and `role` (all of the `PlayerActivity` elements.  The server should then store this data using the logic in `app.post("playerlog")` in `server.js`.

Then we don't need to **post** playerlog.  We will just include the details when we  **get**  the healthcheck 

Note: for the player-log I'd like us to start tracking the `activityType` too.  I've made the client-side changes - but we need to send it to the server & store it there, too.

I'm pretty sure there is an outstanding issue with this.

If I remember correctly, I don't think the `node` server is returning the correct `last-activity` value for the current user. I was logged in as `Game Manager`, but it said I hadn't interacted for 20 minutes:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/156155857-c55cb736-5fa3-454e-a121-c1ffef4a65d6.png)
